customManagers.description: Colophon pinned in the docs workflow's docker-run line; the docker manager does not scan run steps, so a regex manager keeps the tag bumping.

packageRules.description: Fixture manifests are paired with a committed golden deps.lock — the testdata fixtures and the Go suite's synthetic rig/internal/cli/deps.lock. A manifest-only bump breaks the fixture and no test run can re-bake the lock.

prBodyNotes: CI runs `rig lock` on this branch and pushes the refreshed `resolver/deps.lock` back, so the lock arrives with the manifest: one command re-bakes both the kernel module and the `runner` module. The `test-jvm8` floor gate is what rejects a bump that drags in a class above class file v52.
